This is architecture-grain organizational content (how the system works), and no strata category exists yet in this repo to hold it, so a standalone mint is warranted rather than forcing it under a narrative leaf.
placements.title: Pipeline mechanics become organizational subject matter
placements.frame: What internal pipeline mechanism — id generation, fallback logic, commit behavior — is this envelope's content actually describing, and does it belong with how the system is built rather than what it decided or sold?

placements.title: Missing ids become the pipeline's own problem to solve
placements.frame: When a memory arrives without an explicit id, which path actually produced the slug — the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback — and did the pipeline still commit successfully?
placements.why: src-1 names the triggering condition (no explicit id supplied) and src-2 names the pipeline's mandated response (produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback, then commit). Together they describe an ongoing pipeline-behavior subject — not a one-time fact but a mechanism future envelopes about id/slug handling, fallback edge cases, or commit failures would keep feeding — so it clears the narrative grain test. Nothing in the (empty) existing graph structure holds this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
